method.orientation: left/right mean image-left/image-right, not anatomical side.
method.no_hair_check: Current eye04 composited only over frozen blank head, with no front hair, back hair or eyebrows. Dark hair fragments remain inside eye04 itself.
method.curve_algorithm: For each stated x, average mean-RGB grayscale over x-1..x+1. diff[y]=g[y+1]-g[y]. Upper edge is y+.5 at minimum diff in y355..365. Lower edge is y+.5 at maximum diff in y371..377. Opening=lower-upper. Fixed search windows and raw points are recorded; no optimization to force symmetry. Curve samples span each central opening; visible iris-edge core anchors are left x458/466 and right x564/572. Supporting lateral samples can land on a lower crease and are retained transparently, not used in core summary. Broad medians must not be interpreted as exact anatomical areas.
method.curve_limit: Coarse painted dark-edge estimate around the iris, not a full anatomical segmentation. Nearby fold shadows, eyelash paint and baked hair can bias edge detection by1-2px. The edge samples establish the right upper-edge displacement; they are not ready-to-import control points. A trial at x566/570 intersected baked/source hair and is intentionally not treated as clean upper-lid geometry. Core anchors were read against native visual boundaries; uncertainty is retained rather than interpreting a hair-edge derivative as the lid.
method.pupil_core_algorithm: Within recorded half-open ROI, weights=max(100-meanRGB,0), centroid of native coordinates. Same ROI for source and current.
method.pupil_core_limit: Approximately1px reading uncertainty. These are painted dark-core centroids; source/current baked hair and glints can bias them, especially right. They must not justify per-pupil scaling or serve as exact anatomical circle centers.
method.iris_algorithm: Coarse manual horizontal visible outer-limbus endpoints on the same native frame. x span is diameter; native image source current side compared at identical scale.
method.iris_limit: Eyelids cover the vertical iris. Full circle diameter is not inferred from aperture height; source right iris is partly crossed by original hair. Horizontal estimates do not show a disproportionate enlargement of one iris.
